messages:
daria: Observed a weird path in the latest canary: we do a speculative demote (emit token immediately) to reduce latency, but the new owner served reads that missed a very recent put. Log: 

``
[2026-04-05T02:11:06Z] speculative-demote: prefix=user77/cart epoch=412 token=sd:9
[2026-04-05T02:11:06Z] put key=user77/cart:item42 v=qty=1 -> ok @old-owner
[2026-04-05T02:11:07Z] handoff-ack accepted token=sd:9
[2026-04-05T02:11:07Z] read key=user77/cart:item42 -> v=0 (missing)
```

ben: Speculative demote was intentional to avoid tail on evict, but correctness gap is bad. Are we sure the put reached the store/seq before demote?

daria: Put returned ok to client, so sequencer thought it was applied. But it seems the apply may have been in-memory and not visible to new owner.

mike: Two orthogonal mitigations: (A) conservative: slow speculative demote until commit ack from durable store; (B) optimistic: keep speculative demote but mark prefix as "recently-speculative" and force reads to check sequencer for last N ms.

ben: (B) seems closer to current perf goals. Instead of full forwarding on every read, maybe fast-path: on first read miss, fetch last_seq from sequencer and do delta-prefetch. That makes the penalty pay-on-first-read only.

daria: That still requires sequencer to be authoritative for last_seq and reachable. Is sequencer in the critical path for reads today? We try to avoid it for latency reasons.

mike: We can keep it optional: feature-flag the fast-first-read-prefetch for speculative demote flows. Implementation: token includes last_committed_seq; new owner on miss does a single RPC to sequencer: give me ops > seq for prefix -> apply locally -> satisfy read. Timeout short (100ms) then fallback to forwarding.

ben: Need to guarantee the old owner can't ACK handoff with an out-of-date last_committed_seq. So old owner must persist or at least flush a tiny commit marker before signing token. That's similar to earlier patterns but smaller IO footprint: append small marker to local durable log (not full data).

daria: Perf impact seems limited; we should measure append QPS during a simulated eviction storm. Also add metric speculative-demote-first-read-latency and seq-prefetch-fallback-rate.

ci-bot: Created ticket RM-4042: "speculative-demote-prefetch-first-read" assigned to mike. :white_check_mark:

mike: I'll prototype with a confirm-on-token pattern + single-shot sequencer delta fetch on first miss. We'll gate behind ff and add canary checklist.

daria: Thanks. If canary looks good, we can avoid full demote-blocking while still preserving R/W semantics on the common path.

ben: Also add a small reconcile job that periodically scans speculative prefixes and forces a full prefill if any inconsistencies seen in telemetry.

mike: +1. I'll include that in the RFC PR.
